name: smwmusic-lycanthorn-darkness-arises-castle-intro-stage
title: Lycanthorn - Darkness Arises ~ Castle Intro Stage v3 (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of the castle intro stage theme (ver. 3) from the Castlevania inspired game / DOOM mod, Lycanthorn, which is actually just a remix of Bloody Tears from Castlevania II. It's an amazing mod / game with an amazing OST to go alongside it, so if you get the time, given this game a try.

This baby is great for castles, towers, factories, dark forests, dark caverns, other dark stages, final areas, and Transylvania.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also 2 customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Dracula X Pitch)
3. D Minor (Castlevania IV Pitch)
